part.text:
The user is asking how to make opencode stop repeatedly asking for permission confirmation. According to the skills, the `permission` setting in opencode.json controls this. To reduce the prompts, you can set the permission action to "allow" for specific tools, or use the shorthand `"permission": "allow"` to allow everything (although it's noted that this is "rarely what the user wants").
